Ava (CFO): Quick follow-up from today’s all-hands — posting a thread for any leftover questions about runway, hiring, and cost controls. TL;DR: runway ~14 months at current burn, hiring only for critical roles, tightened PO thresholds. Sasha will publish the detailed policy.
Ben (Eng): Thanks — can you confirm whether there’s a hiring freeze? Specifically for infra/SRE hires.
Ava (CFO): Not a full freeze. We’ve approved a small slate of critical IC roles. If you think you need an infra/SRE hire, please add Priya + Sasha to the req and include a 1–2 line business case and expected impact on latency/cost.
Priya (Head of Product): And to be explicit: product hires need a short OKR alignment note. I put a template here: https://docs.redwood.ai/hiring/templates/req-template
Miguel (Sales): What changed for vendor approvals — p-card vs PO vs exec signoff? We have an SOW to sign next week.
Sasha (Finance Ops): New thresholds today: p-card up to $5k, PO with manager approval $5k–75k, exec signoff for >$75k. For SOWs that have unusual termination/IP clauses, loop in Legal early. If the SOW is urgent, use the `finance fast-track` and attach a 2-pager justification.
Lily (People Ops): Any cap changes for recruiter budgets or agency spend?
Ava (CFO): Recruiter budgets are capped to current headcount plan; exceptions require exec approval. We’re prioritizing backfills and mission-critical roles.
Elliot (SRE): Clarify runway calculation — do we treat reserved infra commitments as part of runway or as prepaid spend?
Sasha (Finance Ops): Good question — runway in our model = (cash on hand - committed spend) / monthly burn. Committed infra (reserved contracts) are treated as pre-paid and amortized across the commitment period in the model. I’ll post the amortization worksheet.
Ben (Eng): Can you drop the amortization formula here? One-liner is fine.
Sasha (Finance Ops): Sure: `monthly_amort = committed_amount / committed_months`. Will attach the sheet to the finance doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/finance/runway-workbook
Ava (CFO): Action items: Sasha to publish updated procurement policy by Tue; Priya to publish hiring template link; Lily to circulate exception request process. We’ll run a 30-min finance office hours next Wed 11:00am PST for any edge cases.
Miguel (Sales): Any changes to travel approvals for customer meetings/strategic deals?
Ava (CFO): Travel is allowed for strategic deals, but approvals must be documented in Concur and cc: your manager + People Ops for pre-approvals. Use #travel-expense channel for quick questions.
Ben (Eng): During incidents, who can approve emergency infra spend >$20k? We had a situation last month and it was messy.
Sasha (Finance Ops): During incidents: on-call tech lead + SRE exec can approve up to $50k emergency infra spend; finance must be notified within 24 hours and we’ll post a retro. The incident runbook has the flow.
Priya (Head of Product): One more — will product see adjusted budgets for Q3 feature work? We need a runway window for roadmap planning.
Ava (CFO): We’ll do a Q3 reforecast next week. Please bring concrete tradeoffs (deferrals, scope cuts, or cross-team resource shifts) to the reforecast doc: https://docs.redwood.ai/finance/q3-reforecast
Lily (People Ops): I’ll collect hiring exception requests — people can DM me with manager signoff and the Priya/Ava approvals.
Ben (Eng): :thumbsup:
procurement-bot: New procurement form submitted by Ben (Eng): https://forms.internal/req/782 — status: pending manager approval
Sasha (Finance Ops): Got it — reviewing now. If anyone has an urgent vendor need, DM Sasha + put `urgent` in the form title.
Ava (CFO): Thanks all — will share slides + updated policy links in the channel once Sasha posts them. If anything is urgent, flag it here and we’ll triage.
End of thread.
